strings.210-ФЗ статья 11.2 Исправление обещали,: 210-FZ Article 11.2 A correction was promised; the deadline has passed
strings.210-ФЗ, статья 11.2, часть 6. Срок рассм: Law No. 210-ФЗ, Article 11.2, part 6. The complaint consideration period; sending the reasoned reply has a separate deadline.

strings.В вымышленной услуге ошибка признана, за: In the fictional service, the error is acknowledged and the application was forwarded to the issuing body. The correction period set specifically for this service has expired, with no valid grounds to change it. Repeated promises do not contain a result.
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.Вы работаете в подразделении, обеспечива: You work in the unit supporting consideration of a complaint by the proper recipient. Prepare materials and a draft reasoned decision; do not assume the powers of the body providing the service. The case documents determine the specific recipient. This training service applies Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ; no other special federal procedure is specified.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
Yes, the internal notice states this.

strings.Для жалобы на нарушение срока исправлени: A complaint about breach of the correction deadline requires no additional written refusal; the delay itself is the subject.

strings.Заявление на исправление приняли и согла: They accepted my correction application and acknowledged the typo. The period specified in the regulations has passed. They tell me: 'There has been no refusal, so there is nothing to complain about.'

strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью, устанавливающую общий по: Find the article establishing the general procedure for submitting and reviewing pre-trial complaints concerning service provision.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Немедленное удовлетворение любого требов: Immediate satisfaction of every demand without verification
There is no dispute about the original error.
strings.Нет; допустимое основание изменения срок: No; the case establishes no permissible grounds for changing the period.
strings.Обещание без предусмотренного основания: A promise without prescribed grounds does not replace the established deadline or a confirmed result.
A promise does not replace a legal basis.
strings.Обещания достаточно для бесконечного ожи: A promise is enough to justify waiting forever.
strings.Обжалуется нарушение установленного срок: The complaint concerns breach of the prescribed typo-correction period, not a general dispute about the original service delivery time. It must be considered by the authorised recipient within the issuing body.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Опечатка не оспаривается и отказа нет; д: The typo is undisputed and there is no refusal; the required action changes because an already acknowledged correction is overdue.
strings.Орган, выдавший результат. МФЦ передал м: The body that issued the result. The multifunctional service centre forwarded the materials on time.
strings.Оставить жалобу без рассмотрения до полу: Leave the complaint unexamined until a written refusal arrives
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение жалобы именно н: Prepare consideration of a complaint specifically about delayed correction
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение жалобы уполномо: Prepare consideration of the delayed-correction complaint by the body's authorised recipient and follow up the actual result.
strings.Помощник: «Пока сотрудник обещает исправ: Assistant: 'As long as the employee promises a correction, there is no breach of the deadline.'
strings.Попросить заявителя самостоятельно подпи: Ask the applicant to sign the body's file themselves.
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
strings.Проверить выдачу надлежащего исправленно: Verify issuance of a properly corrected result
strings.Проверить исполнителя и отсутствие надле: Check the responsible party and the absence of a valid deadline change
strings.Проверить надлежащее оформление и доступ: Check proper execution and availability of the result; a technical draft does not prove completion.
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Пятидневный срок применяется только при: The five-day period applies only if the word 'refusal' appears on paper.
strings.Разъяснить заявителю дальнейшие действия: Explain the next steps without making the applicant repeat an accepted application
strings.Рассмотреть жалобу на просрочку исправле: Consider the delayed-correction complaint within the prescribed five working days and separately verify issuance of the result.

Review the complaint about delayed correction within the prescribed five working days, and separately check issuance of the result. The typo is not disputed and there is no refusal; the action changes because an already acknowledged correction was not carried out on time.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Сопоставить признанную ошибку и установл: Match the acknowledged error to the established correction deadline
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Считать любое обещание законным продлени: Treat every promise as a lawful extension of the correction period.
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation

strings.Учебное продолжение. Выдавший орган сооб: Training follow-up. The issuing body reported 'corrected', but the completed file is unsigned and cannot be used as the service result.

strings.Часть 6 статьи 11.2 охватывает не только: Article 11.2, part 6 covers not only refusal to correct errors but complaints about breach of the prescribed correction period. That period is confirmed and has expired in this case; no new negative act needs to be awaited.
